map.评估抗SSA(Ro52/Ro60)和抗SSB(La)抗体的临床关联、疾病指向及妊: Assesses clinical associations, disease direction and pregnancy management of anti-SSA (Ro52/Ro60) and anti-SSB (La) antibodies
map.干燥综合征、皮肌炎、间质性肺病、新生儿狼疮: Sjogren's, dermatomyositis, interstitial lung disease, neonatal lupus
map.SLE可能性增大，需查dsDNA等: SLE more likely; check dsDNA etc.
map.：抗SSA+母亲胎儿发生率2%，抗Ro52阳性风险更高: : fetal incidence 2% in anti-SSA+ mothers, higher with anti-Ro52 positive
map.：新生儿环形红斑，通常6个月内自行消退: : neonatal annular rash, usually resolves within 6 months
map.CHB一旦发生不可逆，可能需要起搏器: Once CHB occurs it is irreversible, may need pacemaker
map.抗SSA+孕妇需从妊娠16周起每1-2周胎儿超声心动图监测: Anti-SSA+ pregnant women need fetal echocardiography every 1-2 weeks from week 16
map.提示：抗SSA/SSB阳性不等于干燥综合征，需结合临床和唇腺活检等综合判断。抗R: Note: anti-SSA/SSB positivity does not equal Sjogren's; combine with clinical and labial gland biopsy. Anti-Ro52 closely relates to interstitial lung disease, recommend HRCT and pulmonary function. Anti-SSA-positive patients need vigilance for lymphoma risk (6-16x higher than normal). Pregnancy with anti-SSA+ needs obstetric + rheumatology co-management, consider prophylactic hydroxychloroquine. For clinical reference only.
map.SSA Ro60+ 且 SSB 阳性、补体低、口干眼干+关节痛 → 支持 pSS: SSA Ro60+ and SSB positive, low complement, dry mouth/eyes + arthralgia → supports pSS; if pregnant and SSA+, monitor fetal heart block (neonatal lupus risk), mother on hydroxychloroquine.
map.ANA 高+RF+SSA/SSB 双阳+口眼干 → 符合原发性干燥综合征分类，查: High ANA + RF + SSA/SSB double positive + dry mouth/eyes → meets primary Sjogren's classification, check Schirmer and labial biopsy.
map.Ro60 与 Ro52 意义不同，Ro52 更关联肌炎/间质肺；双阳(pSS): Ro60 and Ro52 differ; Ro52 more relates to myositis/interstitial lung; double positive (pSS) raises lymphoma and neonatal lupus risk.
map.母体 SSA 可经胎盘致胎儿心脏传导阻滞，孕 16–24 周胎心监护，必要时羟氯: Maternal SSA crosses placenta causing fetal heart block; fetal monitoring weeks 16-24, hydroxychloroquine prophylaxis if needed.
map.抗SSA/SSB抗体干燥综合征相关评估器，评估抗SSA(Ro)和抗SSB(La): Anti-SSA/SSB antibody Sjogren's-related assessor evaluates the clinical significance of anti-SSA (Ro) and anti-SSB (La) antibodies in Sjogren's, SLE and neonatal lupus. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
